item.title: Tsuruma Park: Nagoya's Great Hanami Gathering — Guide
item.description: Tsuruma Park, opened in 1909 as Nagoya’s first public park, is the city’s great hanami stage: some 700 cherry trees, mostly clouds of Somei-Yoshino, bloom in late March and early April over a gracious landscape of fountains, a Western-style rose garden and a Japanese garden. This is where Nagoya comes to celebrate spring in earnest — blue tarpaulins and office parties pack the lawns by mid-morning, food stalls line the paths, and after dark lanterns and lights turn the central avenues into glowing tunnels of blossom for yozakura night viewing.
